title: Mixed upper bounds
statement:
Retain $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, geometric Frobenius, and a field embedding
$\iota:\DLRQ\hookrightarrow\mathbf C$. Let $X_0$ be a $k_0$-scheme of finite type,
with the coefficient framework of [def-sf-categories] at $\Lambda=\DLRQ$. A
constructible Weil sheaf $F$ on $X_0$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] is *$\iota$-mixed of weights at most
$w$* if it has a finite filtration by Weil subsheaves
$0=G_0\subset G_1\subset\cdots\subset G_n=F$ whose successive quotients
$G_{i}/G_{i-1}$ are each punctually $\iota$-pure of some weight
$v_i\le w$ [def-weil-punctual-weights]: every eigenvalue $\alpha$ of every
local geometric Frobenius $F_y$, $y\in|X_0|$, on the stalk of
$G_i/G_{i-1}$ satisfies $|\iota(\alpha)|=q_y^{v_i/2}$ (a condition that uses
$\iota$ only as a field embedding). It is *$\iota$-mixed* if it is $\iota$-mixed of weights at
most $w$ for some $w$. A bounded constructible Weil complex $K$ on $X_0$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] is
*$\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w$* if $\mathcal H^bK$ is
$\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w+b$ for every $b\in\mathbf Z$.

Subobjects, quotients and extensions of Weil sheaves preserve the bound
"$\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w$": intersect a filtration, take its
images, or splice filtrations, respectively.

proof.text: For geometric Frobenius extract ConstructibleTruncationCompatibility from constructibleTruncations_exists [prop-constructible-truncations]. The uniqueness theorem for the common-stage standard t-structure [def-weil-constructible-heart] identifies its chosen t-structure with sfWeilStandardTStructure. Invertible structures are subsingletons, so transport the residue-field inverses to sfWeilPrimeInvertible. The two components of this package give the unique counit-normalized upper and unit-normalized lower truncation comparisons.

The existing Frobenius/cohomology definition composes those comparisons with the recorded shift comparison. For any integer b, tau-ge-b tau-le-b K is both LE b and GE b; the standard shift lemmas put its shift by b in both degree-zero classes. The common-stage heart criterion [def-weil-constructible-heart] proves sfWeilCohomology_mem. All definitions and public signatures remain unchanged.

Let P be the property of being punctually pure of some weight v at most w. It is closed under isomorphisms by composing a finite Weil presentation with the given isomorphism. By [lem-zl-punctual-spectrum-exact-fibre], at every closed point the spectrum is realized by a natural Frobenius automorphism of an exact finite-dimensional fibre. A mono induces an injective intertwiner and an epi a surjective intertwiner. The already proved source lemmas FrobeniusModule.hasEigenvalue_of_injective and hasEigenvalue_of_surjective transfer eigenvalues in the required direction. Thus P is closed under subobjects and quotients.

SfIsMixedOfWeightsAtMost is definitionally the finite mono-chain presentation of P.filtrationClosure. Rewrite with the already proved ObjectProperty.filtrationClosure_iff in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.Extensions. Its proved subobject and quotient closure instances give of_mono and of_epi from the preceding step. Its extension closure gives of_mono_cokernel by applying prop_X2_of_shortExact to the canonical short exact sequence of a mono and its cokernel. This is precisely intersection, image and splicing of filtrations, without constructing them again in the Weil category.
